items.item_text: Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Student Affairs and in the areas of campus climate.

Advanced leadership experience in student activities, student organization advising, leadership development, orientation programs, culturally responsive student support programs and/or first-year experience initiatives.
Experience working in a higher education setting with knowledge of UC campus policies.
Experience managing and evaluating employees in a higher education setting.
Experience with cultural competency and identity development.
This position entails a high degree of independence that requires judgment, discretion, and personal initiative, as well as problem-solving and consensus-building abilities.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Ability to work collaboratively with other staff and community members.

It also requires excellent written and oral communication skills, attention to detail, a broad knowledge of current issues in higher education, and an extensive knowledge of University policies, procedures, and federal mandates, as well as a broad knowledge of campus climate issues and an ability to manage tense or politically-charged situations with political acumen, humility, and respect.

The assistant dean must also have an in-depth knowledge of the Division of Student Affairs as well as sensitivity to the political climate, social justice issues, and campus and community cultural sub-groups and an ability to develop successful collaborations across organizational boundaries.
